about.title: Founded to help keep Houston beautiful
text: ELM was founded nearly 40 years ago with the mission of helping to keep Houston beautiful, and as it has grown, that mission has grown with it.
Owner Christophe Merriam started at ELM more than 10 years ago, working alongside employees in the field and in the office, and took over after the previous owners retired.

His mantra, "relentless execution", is there to remind every member of the team to make each project perfect. Under his leadership ELM has grown to two offices and hundreds of commercial and residential clients.
